title: Finite-level compact-support direct image commutes with restriction of scalars
statement:
Let $X,Y$ be schemes, let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated morphism of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $c=(j,\bar f)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{\bar f}Y$, be a compactification of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]: $j$ an open immersion, $\bar f$ proper, $\bar f j=f$. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible on $Y$ (its image in $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ is a unit), and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings (for instance the reduction $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an integer $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]). For $W\in\{X,\overline X,Y\}$ let $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi:\Sh(W_{\mathrm{proet}},B)\to\Sh(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] along the induced map of constant sheaves of rings $A_W\to B_W$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; it is exact, so applied termwise it defines a triangulated functor $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi:D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},B)\to D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. Let $Rf^{c,A}_{!}=R\bar f^{A}_{*}\,j_!$ and $Rf^{c,B}_{!}=R\bar f^{B}_{*}\,j_!$ be the compact-support candidates attached to $c$ with coefficients $A$ and $B$, defined by these composite formulas, built from the extension by zero $j_!$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero] and the derived direct image defined with K-injective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Then there is an isomorphism of functors $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$

$$
 Rf^{c,A}_{!}\circ\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\circ Rf^{c,B}_{!},
$$

natural in the argument, namely the composite of the identification $j_!\operatorname{Res}_\varphi=\operatorname{Res}_\varphi j_!$ (both are computed termwise on the underlying sheaves of abelian groups) with the isomorphism $R\bar f^{A}_{*}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\cong\operatorname{Res}_\varphi R\bar f^{B}_{*}$ of [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars] for $\bar f$. For composable homomorphisms $A\to B\to C$ of finite commutative rings these isomorphisms compose to the one for $A\to C$.

proof.text: Put $p=\bar f$, $J_R=j_!^R$ and $r_\theta=\operatorname{Res}_\theta$. The direct-image restriction theorem supplies exactness of scalar restriction and its termwise triangulated descent. In the following formulas identify $r_\varphi r_\psi$ with $r_{\psi\varphi}$ by the canonical sectionwise-identity comparison $\rho$, including its exact localization.

source.place: Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition), through the normalized direct-image restriction theorem

proof.text: Apply coherent open-extension scalar restriction to $j$ and the given finite rings. It supplies the presheaf-identity-normalized $e_\varphi:J_A r_\varphi\cong r_\varphi J_B$ on the unbounded derived categories and $e_{\psi\varphi}=r_\varphi(e_\psi)\circ e_\varphi r_\psi$. The open-immersion hypothesis is part of the chosen compactification.

source.place: Tag 03DI, label lemma-extension-by-zero: sheafified extension-by-zero construction; coefficient coherence and its unbounded localization are the agent-written argument extracted from former steps 2–3 of lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars.

proof.text: For the specified direct-image comparisons $\beta_\theta:P_Rr_\theta\cong r_\theta P_S$, $P_R=Rp_*^R$, apply the normalized coefficient cocycle to $p$. Thus $\beta_{\psi\varphi}=r_\varphi(\beta_\psi)\circ\beta_\varphi r_\psi$. Define $\alpha_{\varphi,K}=\beta_{\varphi,J_BK}\circ P_A(e_{\varphi,K})$. Its endpoints are $P_AJ_A r_\varphi K$ and $r_\varphi P_BJ_BK$, precisely the compact-support candidates in the statement. Both factors are natural isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 070Y, label lemma-K-injective-defined: computation on K-injectives; the coefficient cocycle and canonical restriction-associator normalization are the agent-written argument of former steps 5–8 of lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars, using the normalized direct-image comparison.

proof.text:
Expand $\alpha_{\psi\varphi,K}$ with the two cocycles. Naturality of $\beta_\varphi$ on $e_{\psi,K}$ gives
$$\beta_{\varphi,r_\psi J_CK}\circ P_A(r_\varphi e_{\psi,K})=r_\varphi P_B(e_{\psi,K})\circ\beta_{\varphi,J_Br_\psi K}.$$
Substitution and associativity give $\alpha_{\psi\varphi,K}=r_\varphi(\alpha_{\psi,K})\circ\alpha_{\varphi,r_\psi K}$. Restoring $\rho$ gives exactly the canonical coefficient-composition identifications. This proves the claimed composition law for the specified composite.
